assumptions: 1 − Tanimoto on Morgan radius-2 bits; the method and threshold given; the `seed` fixes a random pick.
bio.jane/contract.question: How do these molecules cluster, or which are most diverse, on Morgan fingerprints?

description: Cluster or diversity-pick a list of small molecules on 1 − Tanimoto of Morgan radius-2 fingerprints: Butina sphere exclusion (RDKit ClusterData, optional reordering), MaxMin diversity picking (RDKit MaxMinPicker, seeded), or average linkage (UPGMA) cut into k clusters. Indices are 0-based.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

clusters.description: average linkage: how many clusters to cut the tree into.

method.description: the clustering method. Values: butina (Butina (sphere exclusion)), maxmin (MaxMin diversity pick), average (Average linkage (UPGMA)).

molecules.description: the structures: one SMILES or molfile per entry.

picks.description: MaxMin: how many structures to pick.

reordering.description: Butina: recount unassigned neighbors after each cluster.

seed.description: MaxMin: seed of the first pick, as RDKit's seed.

threshold.description: Butina: neighbors within this distance (1 − Tanimoto), 0–1.

name: cluster_molecules

groups.description: Butina and average linkage: clusters of input indices (Butina: centroid first)

picks.description: MaxMin: input indices in pick order

summary.description: the clustering in words, generated from this run

unread.description: input indices RDKit could not read, left out
